description: Golden Q&A for retrieval eval. Questions are paraphrased so they do NOT contain the requirement ID. expect_req_ids lists the requirement(s) that must be retrieved. An empty list means the correct behaviour is to find nothing relevant (answer: 'not specified').

What availability does the payments service promise each month?
How is access to dashboards and reports controlled?
Can I download a report as a spreadsheet or document?
